MonoBrowser 0.5.1

- Usage statistics: pages visited, time spent, files downloaded, blocked requests, and searches
- Lifetime counters with per-day "today" values, shown in a new Statistics window (navigation menu or command palette)
- Most-visited sites list with per-domain counts
- Statistics persist across restarts in a dedicated `stats.json`; clearing history does not reset them
- Time tracking only counts while the browser window is focused
- Navigation menu now sizes itself to fit all items on open (Statistics and Content blocking entries included)
- Fixed a spurious `ERR_ABORTED` error logged when the navigation menu opened
- `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` is now in English

Downloads:
- Windows: `MonoBrowser-Setup-0.5.1.exe`
- Linux: `MonoBrowser-0.5.1-x86_64.AppImage`
